name: Do outdoor kitchens require building permits?

mainEntity.name: Do outdoor kitchens require building permits?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, outdoor kitchens typically need building permits for gas lines, electrical, plumbing, concrete pads, and structures over 120 sq ft; compliance ensures safety and insurance coverage.
